The corner of a low red brick letterbox pillar is at the edge of the frame. The frame shows only the rear door, the wheel arch and the rear tyre. design.notes: The repair quote names the right rear door and right rear quarter panel; the claimant says the left side. The mismatch is unrelated to dates, so no review indicator applies. Not planted as the innocent_non_date_inconsistency control; the pack exercises the conflicting condition only.

triage.rationale: The repair quote says the right rear door and right rear quarter panel, while the claimant and the photo describe the left side. The material contradicts the statement and nothing in the pack corrects the quote, so someone must follow it up. It is not a date conflict, so the review indicators stay none. Single vehicle, own letterbox, nobody hurt, car drivable, quote NZD 2,443.75 including GST. Coverage is not unclear: the pack policy carries no uncertainty marker in the lookup, and coverage = review_required on its own does not count (maintainer, 2026-09-30). The pack policy must be in the lookup (setup.policies_in_system).

policy_inception_30d.basis: The lookup holds only the current period start (1 April 2026), which changes at every renewal, so the system cannot see how new the policy is; today it is not checked. The original inception date in the pack design, 2018-04-01, is more than 30 days before the incident, so the rule would give clear.
